Still no impact. So far, I've tried 5 actions, all no_impact: RIGHT, click on blue square, click on bar, click on right end.
Maybe the game is one where the arrow keys move a hidden cursor, and that cursor is only visible as a highlight after some operation? Or maybe the arrow keys need to be pressed multiple times to move the blue square (e.g., the square only moves when it's aligned with the bar?). The blue square is at rows 17-22, and the bar is at rows 19-22 (upper part is rows 19-20, lower part is rows 21-22). The square's S interior is at rows 18-21. Hmm.
Wait — maybe the arrow keys do move the square, but the movement is blocked because the square isn't aligned with the bar? The bar's upper part is at rows 19-20. The square spans rows 17-22. If the square moves right, it would collide with the bar... unless the bar is a path that the square slides on top of.
Or maybe the arrow keys move the square, but the square can only move when there's empty space. To the right of the square is the bar (rows 19-20), so RIGHT is blocked. To the left is empty space (black). Let me try LEFT! If the square moves left, then it's a player, and the bar is an obstacle.
Let me try LEFT and UP.
